defectClosed.title: the greater-than-100-MB path destroyed the only durable copy
defectClosed.detail: The volume step exited nonzero before the verified upload. GitHub applies an implicit success() to any step whose if: contains no status-check function, so the verified upload was skipped — and the incomplete-forensic upload was skipped too, its explicit condition being false when Actor 2 and Job C succeeded. A run producing 104857601 bytes would have detected the threshold and then discarded the evidence when the runner disappeared.
defectClosed.correction: the measurement is nonfatal and produces a decision; the verified artifact is uploaded, redownloaded by exact ID, digest-compared and content-verified on both sides of the limit; the stop is a terminal adjudication that runs only after the artifact and receipt exist

wordingCorrected: the trigger paths set contains three files, not two
